_doc: Agent-cost ratchet (ADR-0037), checked by tests/agent_cost_ratchet_test.rs against docs/generated/measured.json. shrink: may only go down; grow: may only go up; zero: must stay 0. A better measured value must be written here in the same change. feeds: the paths whose changes alter what the replay measures; measured.json must have been recorded at a commit after the last change to any of them (the staleness test).
